newsitem.title: USA: AMR American to order Boeing planes - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: AMR American to order Boeing planes - WSJ.

text.p: U.S. airline American Airlines of AMR Corp plans to announce on Thursday an order for "several hundred" new Boeing jets worth almost $6 billion to be delivered through 2020, the Wall Street Journal reported.

In its Wednesday edition, the newspaper cited "people familiar with the company's plans" as saying the firm short-term order will be for a little more than 100 aircraft, including 12 long-range 777's.
It said the airline also intended to order about 75 Boeing 737's, 12 757's and "several" 767's.
The newspaper said the contract is for a total of about 500 to 600 aircraft, which will mostly replace older models in the fleet like Airbus and Fokker.
They will also bring about a "moderate" expansion in American's capacity, it said, adding that an airline spokesman declined to comment.
The newspaper said American would not make the announcement before the leaders of the airline's pilot union vote to bring a recently negotiated agreement to their membership for approval.
The Allied Pilots Association is to make its vote on Wednesday, it said.
